question: Estimate monthly transaction volume (₹) on PhonePe.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total Payment Volume across UPI + bills + recharges + wallet? Yes — TPV.
Include merchant payments (P2M) and P2P? Both.
Include investments (mutual funds, gold) routed via PhonePe? Exclude — payment TPV only.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: total UPI TPV in India × PhonePe market share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total UPI TPV in India (monthly avg 2026): ~₹24-25 lakh Cr (vs ₹20 lakh Cr in early 2024 — ~25% YoY growth).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: PhonePe UPI market share by value: ~48-50% (Google Pay ~36%, others ~14%).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Add non-UPI flows (bills, recharges, gift cards, ATM withdrawal via UPI): ~10% extra = ~₹1.2 lakh Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total UPI TPV in India (monthly avg 2026)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹24-25 lakh Cr (vs ₹20 lakh Cr in early 2024 — ~25% YoY growth).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: PhonePe UPI market share by value

calculationFlow: Total UPI TPV in India (monthly avg 2026): ~₹24-25 lakh Cr (vs ₹20 lakh Cr in early 2024 — ~25% YoY growth).
Monthly UPI TPV PhonePe: ₹24.5L Cr × 0.49 = ~₹12 lakh Cr.
Add non-UPI flows (bills, recharges, gift cards, ATM withdrawal via UPI): ~10% extra = ~₹1.2 lakh Cr.
